title: Maria Bartiromo Is Out at Fox News
description: The dismissal came after Ms. Bartiromo shared internal Fox Business communications with the White House, a person familiar with the details confirmed.
author: Erik Wemple

title: Trump Administration Asks Supreme Court to Allow Mail Voting Limits
description: The justices have been asked to weigh in again on the Trump administration’s efforts to restrict mail voting — this time on whether the plans violate the Constitution.
author: Abbie VanSickle

title: Gloria Steinem Deserves to Be Remembered as a Writer Too
description: Her 1983 book “Outrageous Acts and Everyday Rebellions” is a master class in grit, empathy, curiosity and hustle.
author: Veronica Chambers

title: Bessent Blames Ukraine for High Energy Prices
description: After meeting with Russia’s finance minister, the Treasury secretary said Ukraine’s attacks on Russian oil infrastructure were contributing to a global energy shock driven mainly by the U.S. war with Iran.
author: Alan Rappeport

title: Why a Doctor Told Gloria Steinem: ‘You Must Promise Me Two Things’
description: Gloria Steinem got to be who she was because of a pre-Roe abortion.
author: Jill Filipovic

title: The Start-Up That Helps People Die
description: Medical aid in dying is now legal in New York. A team of clinical professionals decided to create a practice to help their clients die on their own terms.
author: Emma Goldberg and Erin Schaff

title: U.S. Trade Gap Ballooned in July
description: The trade deficit bounced back up last month as spending on data centers to feed the A.I. boom drove up imports.
author: Ana Swanson

title: It’s OK to Admit It. The State of the World Is Terrifying.
description: Exit, Trump. Enter, what?
author: Frank Bruni and Bret Stephens

title: The President Can’t Handle the Truth
description: Trump’s fantasy-reality problem is deepening.
author: Jamelle Bouie

title: Scientists Find More Than 1,000 DNA Variants Linked to Personality Traits
description: More than one million genomes helped identify DNA variants linked to extroversion, agreeableness, neuroticism and more. Researchers measured how those traits influenced how people lived.
author: Emily Baumgaertner Nunn

title: What Did Jurassic Forests Sound Like? Like This.
description: Scientists spent over a decade reconstructing the calls of nine species of ancient insects to create the first accurate Jurassic soundscape.
author: Annie Roth

title: Patagonia Sues Trump Over Reduction of Bears Ears National Monument in Utah
description: The outdoor apparel maker joined environmental and Native American groups in challenging President Trump’s reduction of Bears Ears National Monument.
author: Maxine Joselow

title: In Small Iranian Town, a U.S. Attack Turns a Wedding Into a Tragedy
description: The bomb that hit the residential area was American, according to a weapons expert and a visual analysis by The Times. It killed five people and wounded 67 others, the Iranian authorities said.
author: Christiaan Triebert, Malachy Browne, Farnaz Fassihi and Erika Solomon

title: Is Steve Hilton the Future of Trumpism?
description: Steve Hilton wants to “Make California Golden Again.”
author: Samuel Earle

title: I Went to Princeton to Become a So-So Indian
description: I realized that in this country Indians were not supposed to be happy or to pursue happiness. We were supposed to suffer and to pursue suffering.
author: David Treuer

title: USPS Is Building a Mail-In Ballot Screening System Despite Legal Battles Over Trump Order
description: Election officials warn that the creation of a new online portal for states to upload voter information is already fueling confusion and could ultimately disenfranchise voters.
author: Eileen Sullivan

title: Trump Administration Launches Hunt For Noncitizen Voter Fraud Before Midterms
description: Election fraud is exceedingly rare, but President Trump has fixated on rooting it out this year, claiming without evidence that tens of thousands of noncitizens are registered to vote.
author: Nick Corasaniti and Hamed Aleaziz

title: Wendell Berry, Writer Who Extolled America’s Agrarian Past, Dies at 92
description: A Kentucky farmer, he railed against agribusiness and championed small family farms and the environment, winning widespread acclaim.
author: Robert D. McFadden

title: Kennedy Center Removes ‘Blue’ Sculpture That Was an Artist’s Gift
description: The towering artwork, added to the campus in 2019, was targeted for elimination after President Trump’s takeover of the center.
author: Elizabeth Williamson and Julia Jacobs

title: Wondering How Nuts Trump’s Tariffs Are? Consider Aluminum.
description: Canada is better at making aluminum than we are. Let’s just import it and make something else.
author: Bill Saporito
